Town Public Meeting & Events Calendar

Public meetings may be held at Whipple Town Hall, 25 Seamans Road or may be held at the Town Office Syd Crook conference room, 375 Main St. Please refer to the meeting calendar &/or agendas for the location of the meeting.

The board or committee, if so voted, may enter into non-public session to discuss appropriate items listed under RSA 91-A:3 II (a-h).

Minutes of past meetings will be available as soon as possible following the meeting.  Click for minutes.  If you are looking for minutes that have not been posted to the website, please e-mail the Board of Selectmen's Office to see if a draft is available.

If you need information that is not available here, please contact the Board of Selectmen's Office at (603) 526-1242.
